question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The list of items are (A) / kept on the table (B) / near the door. (C)
explanation: Subject 'list' singular है; 'of items' सिर्फ modifier है। इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा (The list of items is kept...)।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Neither the manager nor his assistants (A) / was aware of (B) / the changes in the policy. (C)

options.text: Neither the manager nor his assistants

explanation: Neither...nor में verb nearest subject के अनुसार लगती है। Nearest subject 'assistants' plural है, इसलिए 'was' → 'were aware of'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

Each of the students [have submitted] the assignment before the deadline.
explanation: 'Each of' के बाद singular verb आती है। इसलिए 'has submitted' सही है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

This year, (A) / the number of applicants for the post (B) / have increased significantly. (C)

options.text: the number of applicants for the post

explanation: 'The number of' + plural noun के साथ singular verb आती है (जबकि 'A number of' के साथ plural)। इसलिए 'has increased'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Mathematics, along with physics and chemistry, (A) / are taught (B) / in the first year. (C)

options.text: Mathematics, along with physics and chemistry,

explanation: 'Along with' से subject plural नहीं बनता। Subject 'Mathematics' singular है, इसलिए 'is taught' आएगा।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

The committee [are divided] in its opinion on the new proposal.
explanation: 'Its' singular pronoun बता रहा है कि committee को एक unit माना गया है, इसलिए verb singular 'is divided' होगी।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

I have met him last Sunday (A) / at the market (B) / near my house. (C)

options.text: I have met him last Sunday

explanation: Last Sunday जैसे definite past time के साथ Simple Past आता है, Present Perfect नहीं। सही: 'I met him last Sunday'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

By the time we reached the station, the train [already left].
explanation: दो past actions में जो पहले हुई उसके लिए Past Perfect (had + V3) आता है। ट्रेन पहले जा चुकी थी, इसलिए 'had already left'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

She has been (A) / teaching in this school (B) / since ten years. (C)
explanation: अवधि (period) के साथ 'for' और निश्चित समय-बिंदु के साथ 'since' लगता है। सही: 'for ten years'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

I [am knowing] the answer to this question.
explanation: 'Know' stative verb है, इसका continuous form नहीं बनता। सही: 'I know the answer'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The sun (A) / rose in the east (B) / and sets in the west. (C)
explanation: Universal truth हमेशा Simple Present में होता है। सही: 'rises in the east'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

He [has been working] in this company since 2010.
explanation: Since + point of time के साथ Present Perfect Continuous सही है, इसलिए sentence पहले से सही है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

He is suffering with (A) / a high fever and (B) / needs complete rest. (C)
explanation: Suffer के साथ preposition 'from' आता है। सही: 'suffering from'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

She is allergic [of] dust and pollen.
explanation: 'Allergic' के बाद 'to' आता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The teacher was angry (A) / with the student (B) / for being late. (C)
explanation: Person पर गुस्से के लिए 'angry with' सही है, इसलिए sentence सही है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

The property was divided [between] the five heirs.
explanation: दो के बीच 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' आता है। यहाँ पाँच heirs हैं।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

My friend, who is a lawyer, (A) / has recently (B) / got married with a doctor. (C)

options.text: My friend, who is a lawyer,

explanation: 'Marry' या 'be married' के बाद 'to' आता है। सही: 'married to a doctor'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

My brother is senior [than] me by three years.
explanation: Senior, junior, superior, inferior, prefer के साथ 'than' नहीं, 'to' आता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

He is an honest man (A) / and a M.A. (B) / in Economics. (C)
explanation: 'M.A.' का उच्चारण 'em-ay' (vowel sound) से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'an M.A.' आएगा। Article का चुनाव spelling नहीं, sound से होता है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

[The honesty] is the best policy.
explanation: Abstract noun (honesty) के पहले general sense में article नहीं लगता।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Moon revolves around the Earth (A) / and the Earth revolves (B) / around the Sun. (C)
explanation: Unique चीज़ों (the Moon, the Sun, the Earth) के पहले 'the' लगता है। सही: 'The Moon'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

[A Himalayas are] the highest mountain range in the world.
explanation: पर्वत-श्रृंखलाओं (mountain ranges) के नाम के पहले 'the' आता है और Himalayas plural है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Between you and I, (A) / this plan is (B) / not going to work. (C)
explanation: Preposition (between) के बाद object case आता है। सही: 'Between you and me'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

Let you and [I] go to the market together.
explanation: 'Let' के बाद object case आता है, इसलिए 'Let you and me'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The man (A) / whom I thought (B) / was honest cheated me. (C)
explanation: 'Was honest' का subject यही pronoun है, इसलिए subject case 'who' आएगा ('I thought' parenthetical है)। सही: 'who I thought was honest'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

They blamed [theirselves] for the failure.
explanation: Plural reflexive pronoun 'themselves' होता है; 'theirselves' नहीं होता।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Of all the students, (A) / Ravi is the (B) / most cleverest. (C)
explanation: Double superlative नहीं लगता। सही: 'the cleverest' (या 'the most clever')।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

He is the (A) / more intelligent (B) / of the two brothers. (C)
explanation: दो की तुलना में comparative degree आती है। 'The more intelligent of the two' सही construction है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Gold is (A) / costlier than (B) / any other metals. (C)
explanation: 'Any other' के बाद singular noun आता है। सही: 'any other metal'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

He is [a ten-years-old] boy.
explanation: Compound adjective में number के बाद noun singular रहता है (hyphen के साथ)। सही: 'a ten-year-old boy'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

She sings very good (A) / in the choir (B) / every Sunday. (C)
explanation: Verb को modify करने के लिए adverb चाहिए। 'Good' adjective है, सही: 'very well'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

He worked so [hardly] that he fell ill.
explanation: 'Hard' adjective और adverb दोनों है ('कड़ी मेहनत से'); 'hardly' का अर्थ 'मुश्किल से / लगभग नहीं' होता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

Unless you (A) / do not work hard, (B) / you will fail. (C)
explanation: 'Unless' खुद negative अर्थ रखता है, इसलिए उसके साथ 'not' नहीं लगता। सही: 'Unless you work hard'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

[Although he was tired, but] he completed the work.
explanation: Although / Though के साथ 'but' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

No sooner had (A) / he seen the police (B) / when he ran away. (C)
explanation: 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है ('Hardly / Scarcely' के साथ 'when')। सही: 'than he ran away'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

You ought (A) / not to waste (B) / your precious time on such trivial matters. (C)

options.text: your precious time on such trivial matters.

explanation: 'Ought' के बाद 'to' + V1 आता है और negative 'ought not to' होता है। Sentence सही है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

I would rather [to stay] at home than go out.
explanation: 'Would rather' के बाद bare infinitive (V1) आता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

She made me to wait (A) / for an hour (B) / outside the office. (C)
explanation: 'Make' के बाद bare infinitive आता है, 'to' नहीं। सही: 'made me wait'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

He is accustomed [to get up] early in the morning.
explanation: 'Accustomed to' में 'to' preposition है, इसलिए उसके बाद V+ing आती है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

[Being a rainy day], we stayed at home.
explanation: Participle का अपना अलग subject हो तो absolute construction बनता है: 'It being a rainy day'।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

If it rains tomorrow, (A) / the match will be (B) / called off. (C)
explanation: First conditional: If + Simple Present, will + V1। Sentence सही है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

If I [was] you, I would accept the offer.
explanation: Imaginary / unreal condition में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' आता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The new bridge (A) / is been constructed (B) / by the engineers. (C)
explanation: Present continuous passive: is/are + being + V3। सही: 'is being constructed'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

He said that he [will come] to my house the next day.
explanation: Reporting verb past होने पर 'will' → 'would' हो जाता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The teacher (A) / gave us (B) / many informations about the course. (C)
explanation: 'Information' uncountable noun है, इसका plural नहीं बनता। सही: 'much information'।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

She is [one of the most intelligent girl] in the class.

options.text: one of the more intelligent girl
one of the most intelligent girls

explanation: 'One of the' के बाद plural noun आता है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

He has [less] friends than his brother.
explanation: Countable noun (friends) के साथ 'fewer' आता है; 'less' uncountable के साथ।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

He has (A) / a few friends (B) / and so he feels lonely. (C)
explanation: 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' (positive) और 'few' का अर्थ 'लगभग नहीं' (negative) होता है। अकेलेपन के भाव के लिए 'few friends' सही है।

question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the segment given in square brackets. If no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement'.

She enjoys [to sing, dancing, and to paint] in her free time.

options.text: to sing, to dance, and painting

explanation: Parallelism: सभी items का form एक जैसा होना चाहिए। 'Enjoy' के बाद gerund (V+ing) आता है।

question:
Select the part of the sentence that contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

She asked (A) / me why (B) / was I late for the meeting. (C)

options.text: was I late for the meeting.

explanation: Indirect (reported) question में सीधा order (subject + verb) रहता है। सही: 'why I was late'।
